marta (docs): Heads up, found a mismatch in the /generate endpoint examples. The request examples show `max_new_tokens` in the JSON body but our API expects `max_new_tokens` under the `generation` object now. Breaking a few user examples. Opening a docs PR to update samples and add a short migration note.

sam (sdk): Ack. Our JS and Go SDKs still accept a top-level `max_new_tokens` for backwards compatibility but recommend the nested shape. We should show both shapes in the migration note and an example of how to call the SDK helper that maps old->new.

kai (eng-runtime): Confirmed runtime accepts both shapes for now, but we plan to deprecate the top-level in the next minor. Docs should be explicit about deprecation timeline and example config for the preferred `generation` object: `{ generation: { max_new_tokens: 256, temperature: 0.7 } }`. Also mention that `max_new_tokens` must be an integer and cannot exceed model max-context minus prompt length.

nate (docs-review): One small ask: the Python snippet currently uses `max_tokens` which is inconsistent with the OpenAPI naming. Please change Python and curl examples to use `generation.max_new_tokens`. Also add an example showing migration via curl (old -> new).

marta (docs): Working on PR now. I'll update curl, python, and node snippets and add a short migration section titled "Transitioning to generation object" that shows the old shape and the new shape side-by-side, plus a note about SDK helper mapping.

sam (sdk): I'll add a tiny helper in the JS client: `client.buildGenerationPayload({max_new_tokens: 50})` that returns the nested shape. Will link the helper in the doc. ETA tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview: preview build queued for PR 3451

marta (docs): Pushed changes to PR 3451. Also fixed a stray example where `temperature` was a string. Replaced with numeric values and added the deprecation callout.

nate (docs-review): LGTM aside from two nits: 1) prefer canonical header casing `Authorization` in curl examples, 2) body examples should be JSON code block with content-type noted.

kai (eng-runtime): Also add a line about runtime behavior when both shapes provided: the `generation` object wins if both are present. Saves folks debugging surprises.

marta (docs): Added that sentence and fixed nits. Also included a short test-case suggestion for QA: send both shapes and assert `generation` wins. Linking to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3451

deploy-bot: deploy-preview: build passed. URL: https://deploy-preview-3451--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/generate#parameters

marta (docs): Merging after CI green. Will follow up to add SDK link when Sam's helper is merged. Thanks! :sparkles:
